name: purs-graphs
description: PureScript FFI bindings for graph visualization (dagre + viz.js) with Halogen examples

scripts.test: spago test -p purs-dagre && spago test -p purs-viz
scripts.test:examples: spago test -p dagre-demo && spago test -p viz-demo && spago test -p showcase
scripts.build:examples: cd examples/dagre-demo && spago build && purs-backend-es build --corefn-dir ../../output --output-dir ../../output-es && npx vite build && cd ../viz-demo && spago build && purs-backend-es build --corefn-dir ../../output --output-dir ../../output-es && npx vite build && cd ../showcase && spago build && purs-backend-es build --corefn-dir ../../output --output-dir ../../output-es && npx vite build
scripts.format: purs-tidy format-in-place packages examples && biome check --write .
scripts.format:check: purs-tidy check packages examples && biome check .
